name: triton_stand_forward_v2_experimental
_about: Single source of truth shared by cad/velocity_task.py (training) and
embedded/ctrl_scripts/run_velocity_policy.py (robot). Change a value here and both follow.
Joint angles are in the SIM convention; sim_to_hw_joint_sign converts to the hardware convention.
Public commands are [forward,lateral,yaw]; plant axes are +X right, +Y forward, +Z up.
_stand_pose_note: Moderate crouch. Feet-welded statics on the CAD model: knee ~2.8 Nm, ankle ~2 Nm holding per leg (RS-02 rated 6 Nm continuous).
_slew_note: Verified deployed position-target slew; hardware limit is not raised for this experiment.
_gains_note: Motor-side MIT gains as sent on CAN. Joint-side ankle gains are kp*r^2 and kd*r^2 (r = ankle_linkage_ratio).
_torque_cap_note: The deployed guard bounds the spring term |kp*(target - pos)| in motor space by pulling the target toward the current position. Training reproduces this exactly.

actor_obs.name: base_ang_vel
actor_obs.units: rad/s, IMU gyro in the base frame

actor_obs.name: projected_gravity
actor_obs.units: unit vector in the base frame, (0, 0, -1) upright

actor_obs.name: last_action
actor_obs.units: raw policy output from the previous step

actor_obs.name: command
actor_obs.units: [forward m/s, lateral m/s, yaw rate rad/s]; public order mapped to plant X right, Y forward

deployment_status: simulation experiment; standing pose, unhealthy ankle and contact are not hardware-qualified
